thread:
deploy-bot: 🚨 Canary alert: unusual token spikes on /v3-text canary (tag: release-2026-03-17-hot). Metric: token_error_rate +18% over baseline. Link: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/s/d1/canary?panelId=12
oncall-alex: I'm on it, paging myself and @oncall-maya
eng-runtime: Seeing embedding variance and garbled prefixes. Sample outputs returning repeated control tokens. Suspect tokenizer mismatch with newly promoted weights.
oncall-maya: Any 5xxs/customer impact? Need scope.
sre-ryan: API gateway 502s spike correlated with inference worker restarts, started 2026-03-17T14:32Z. Raw counts: ~1.2k failed requests last 10m.
customer-success-liz: Received 2 support tickets about gibberish outputs and PII hallucinations. Notified affected customers.
eng-runtime: Quick diff from manifests:
```
prev: "tokenizer": "tok-v1", "vocab_size": 50257
current: "tokenizer": "tok-v2-experimental", "vocab_size": 50000
```
Looks like tokenizer config changed without vocab mapping.
oncall-alex: Flipping traffic to stable variant now: `rbacctl set-flag model.v3.route_canary false --env=prod`
deploy-bot: feature flag model.v3.route_canary set to false by oncall-alex :white_check_mark:
eng-ml: Also seeing weight checksum mismatch on promoted artifact: sha256 differs from build artifact. Possible bad promotion step.
oncall-maya: Initiating rollback to v3.0-stable: `./deploy rollback --model v3 --to v3.0 --force`
deploy-bot: rollback started by oncall-maya, estimated completion ~180s
eng-runtime: Evicting canary pods: `kubectl scale deploy inference-canary --replicas=0 -n prod`
incident-bot: Handoff to night oncall @oncall-ryan in 20m — escalate if resolved not within 30m
oncall-ryan: Ack, monitoring logs and metrics now
eng-runtime: Sample prompt/outputs (canary):
```
> prompt: "Summarize quarterly"
> output: "\u0001\u0001\ud83d\udc7b..."  <-- repeated control tokens + truncated text
```
product-anna: Customers impacted count? Need copy for status page.
sre-ryan: 7 orgs reported (CS reports), ~1200 failed requests, error rate trending back down after flag flip.
customer-success-liz: CS dispatched messages to top 3 customers, legal looped in for PII concern.
eng-ml: Root cause: pipeline promoted artifact with unpinned 'latest' tag; tokenizer binary from older branch got picked up. Also rollout step lacked checksum validation.
oncall-alex: Confirmed traffic routed off canary and rollback in flight. Will keep thread open for postmortem.
eng-runtime: Action items: add artifact pinning + immutable tags, enforce checksum validation in deploy pipeline, add canary health check verifying tokenizer/vocab match before traffic shift :memo:
oncall-maya: Rollback completed at 2026-03-17T14:39Z, canary pods terminated :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Incident marked RESOLVED by oncall-maya. Incident ticket: INC-2026-3147 https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-3147
oncall-ryan: I'll follow up with logs and a short postmortem draft tomorrow. :thumbsup:
